notes.title: Rentlord v1.1.2 - Tenant System Balance Changes
notes.notes:
Tenant System Nerfed – Tenant multipliers no longer stack to absurd levels with eviction tricks. Property and tenant multipliers now interact in a more balanced way.

Growth Glitch Nerfed – Lowered the chance of rolls from %5 -> %3.

Landlord’s Luck Nerfed – Lowered the chance of rolls from %5 -> %3.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Catch Up Achievement – Fixed an issue where the Catch Up achievement was unobtainable due to the it was impossible to earn 150$ from a property.

notes.title: Eviction Update: Upcoming Free Content Update on 28th July!
notes.notes:
Hey Rentlords!

Are you ready to evict single mothers for money?

[h2]Tenant System[/h2]

From now on, every time you buy a property, you’ll get to choose from three different tenants. Each one comes with a unique trait. Some pay more rent. Some boost nearby buildings. Some are just dead weight.

[b]It’s your job to decide who moves in.[/b]
These traits aren’t just for flavor. We’re adding plugins that give bonuses based on tenant traits, opening up entirely new build paths. You can go all-in on lazy tenants, elitists, loyalists, whatever gives you the edge.

[b]And if someone isn’t pulling their weight?[/b]
Evict them. No hesitation. Sometimes eviction leads to more rent

To support this system, 10 new plugins and 1 new portfolio are on the way. They’re built around tenant traits and open up entirely new ways to manipulate your tenants.

[b]Eviction Update is coming on 28th July, as a free content update to the base game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528463/f222c917842faa58a5b0b09e743cd0f4b2920f68.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3546440/Rentlord/

notes.title: Rentlord v1.0.3 - Bug Fix & Enhancements
notes.notes:
Hey Rentlords!

You filthy-rich digital tyrants just got even more dangerous. While your tenants sleep in fear, we’ve been fine-tuning your tools of exploitation, buffing your systems of domination, and trimming the fat from your bloated empire. This update brings ruthless efficiency, crueler balance, and new opportunities to squeeze every last coin out of the grid.

[b]Here’s what’s changed in your kingdom of cash:[/b]

[b]💀 Bug Fixes[/b]  
Crushed a bug where the Growth Glitch plugin didn't obey your commands when using batching.  
Patched up Landlord’s Luck so it now functions exactly as your iron will intends.  
Endless Mode can now actually end. No more hiding behind infinite numbers.  
Fixed inconsistent visuals in the Property Box — your empire should look as polished as it is powerful.  

Open House no longer gives you rentless homes. Freebies are for the poor.

[b]🧠 New Systems[/b]  

Scientific Number Conversion added — because your wealth was getting too absurd for mortal numbers.  
Pay Early System now scales with the week. Early greed gets greater rewards.

[b]⚖️ Balance Changes[/b]  

Zenlord got nerfed. He still meditates, but now he pays rent too.  
Growth Glitch nerfed — no more snowballing into godhood by accident.  
Landlord’s Luck nerfed — you’ll still win, just with a little less divine intervention.  
Scarecrow nerfed — the farms still grow, but they don't print gold anymore.

[b]🛒 Shop Overhaul[/b]  

Introducing the Legendary Tier — twisted, rare, ultra-synergistic plugins forged in the fires of greed itself. Expect chaos. Expect power. Expect pain... for others.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3546440/Rentlord/

Added scroll bars to the Unlocks and Properties apps for better navigation.

notes.title: Rentlord is OUT Now! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  
We’re thrilled (and slightly in debt) to announce that [b]Rentlord[/b] is officially [b]out today on Steam[/b]! 🪩💰

This is our roguelike real estate game where you're not just collecting rent — you’re building chaotic combo engines, unlocking powerful plugins, and trying to survive the week without being crushed by taxes. Every run is a new opportunity to outsmart the system (and your own bad investments).

[quote][b]Buy weird properties, stack wild combos, dodge taxes.[/b] It’s like Monopoly had a roguelike baby.[/quote]

[h2]🏠 What’s Rentlord all about?[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Buy and flip properties[/b] across a range of weird and wonderful types  
[*][b]Install powerful plugins[/b] to turn your buildings into income-generating machines  
[*][b]Stack rent multipliers[/b] and trigger wild synergies  
[*][b]Survive weekly challenges[/b] and randomized events  
[*][b]Avoid taxes[/b] like your landlord’s life depends on it
[/list]

[h2]Free Content Updates[/h2]

Rentlord will get 4 free content updates after the release. We detailed these on this following image, and you can also see a constantly updated version of this roadmap on the main store page of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528463/f222c917842faa58a5b0b09e743cd0f4b2920f68.png[/img]

[h2]💬 Last Words and Your Feedback[/h2]

I'm a solo developer, and thank you for supporting me through development. Thank you all so much for wishlisting and playing the demo. And huge thank you to my publisher [b]Rogue Duck Interactive[/b] and their team, handling all the marketing and coaching me through the making of the game!

Rentlord was a strange idea that became a stranger (and more fun) reality, and we can’t wait to see the combos you cook up. 

Please share your ideas and feedback with me on the Steam Community Forums for the game, or send a [b]Steam Review,[/b] which helps a lot for the visibility of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3546440/Rentlord/

--
